title: Learning produces an orthogonalized state machine in the hippocampus
goal: Reproduce the original learning-dependent hippocampal population decorrelation and state-specific representation findings from longitudinal per-cell activity and matched behavior, using the source-defined animal/session cohorts, regional comparisons and indispensable controls.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Longitudinal hippocampal population decorrelation and state-specific versus position-based representation/stability from per-cell neural activity and matched behavior, including complete source-defined regional comparisons; no automatic whole-paper or every-figure requirement.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: simulation_method: Extended Data 9a generated-sequence next-symbol/reward prediction and related RNN arithmetic remain genuine secondary model evidence; preserve source reward-recall behavior and model/version discrepancies rather than silently replacing its score.
simulation_control: A claimed mechanistic model explanation additionally needs source-defined representation and learning-dynamics comparators against empirical observations; reward performance alone is inadequate. These controls are not automatically imposed on a narrower Figure 2f numerical claim.
prospective_extension: Held-animal prediction and new spatial-model comparison retain proposed-extension status; they do not fill unresolved source-panel mappings.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Author OSM_Paper_Figures c1d1788… loads vr2p ExperimentData and per-animal registered activity/VR; Fig2f uses placefields binF. Small stretched_trials has real observations but is a subset of ~1.5TB release.

versions_and_loader_contract.input_code_bridge: Author README specifies vr2p.ExperimentData and per-animal registered fluorescence/VR trial data. Inspected Fig_2f.ipynb loads Set A animals and per-cell place-field binF from the released placefields archive, then recomputes cross-trial correlation matrices. The smaller stretched_trials archive contains individual neural arrays and matched VR/position files, but does not replace the full longitudinal release.
versions_and_loader_contract.readiness_scope: Learning-dependent population-code orthogonalization and state coding in released longitudinal cohorts; no whole-paper or raw-image processing qualification.

retained_secondary_improvement.improvement_loop: Inactive until original prediction-source recovery. Once admitted, iterate on source-authorized training/validation feedback for the 2ACDC prediction task. The paper reports some regularization choices using test performance; recover and disclose that history before defining comparable access, without treating those historical scores as an untouched holdout.
retained_secondary_improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze algorithm, symbol encoding, original generated-sequence/split identities, context/state handling, model-selection access, score masks, baseline version, uncertainty/effect rule and concrete resource ceilings before final scoring.
retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Independently score frozen candidate and author predictions on the recovered original test-support protocol and exact reward-symbol scoring support, retaining every admitted source condition. Source-equivalent stochastic regeneration is permitted after baseline calibration; a different distribution or corrected split rule remains an extension.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Keep published Extended Data Fig. 9a scores, independently rerun source models and historical Fig. 2f reconstruction separate. Existing correlation evaluator remains calibration and cannot certify the prediction task. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.
